events.event: DPR Commission III deputy chair Ahmad Sahroni said he strongly agrees with revising the UU Tipikor so that business losses at state enterprises are distinguished from officials enriching themselves.
events.why_it_matters: A senior DPR law-committee figure backing the redefinition shows the Tipikor revision has parliamentary support, while critics worry about weaker enforcement.

events.event: DPR Commission III is due to begin discussing the DIM (issue inventory) of the DPR-initiated Asset Forfeiture Bill when the recess ends, with passage targeted no later than 15 December 2026.
events.key_numbers: Recess 9 Oct to 9 Nov 2026 · passage deadline 15 Dec 2026 · 62 RDPU hearings · 8 working visits
events.why_it_matters: The bill would let the state seize assets of corruption suspects without a criminal conviction, and the clock to the 15 Dec target starts in November.
